reviews.comment: This class is not very fun if you don't love math. Nordin is a good professor though, just teaches a boring class. The only critique I have about him is that he gives up to 10 part math problems on the exams on top of a ton of other questions and doesn't give enough time to finish. Other than that, he's a pretty fair professor.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Posts lectures on canvas after class. This class itself is pretty difficult, but he provided questions that helped me prepare for the kind of questions that would be on exams. Lectures can be a bit dull, but he tries his best to answer our questions. Graded only on exams and final exam (not cumulative!). Open note exams! Offers extra credit!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's a super chill guy and really nice. His tests were all open note which was awesome, and he was willing to take feedback from the class of how he could do better and he listens. This class is usually really difficult from what I hear, but he made it bearable. I didn't actually learn much but I got through it fairly easily because of him.
